findings.observation: Observed: PR #12 and PRs #45/#56/#57 are not ancestors of the unified head. PR #12 fuel.mjs is V1 (capacity 10, 5-minute regen, cost 1, ad grant 2); current fuel.mjs is V2 (capacity 30, 1-minute regen, cost 5, grant 10) and migrates V1 saves. PRs #45/#56 patch a floating horizontal joystick; the current runtime imports RaceWheelSteering and uses angular wheel deltas, while retaining pointer-capture fallback and pointerup/pointercancel/lostpointercapture cleanup. Current driver.mjs says the two-key auto-driver is deleted. PR #57 report labels its control lab internal-only and says no formal scheme was selected. Inference: these diffs do not demonstrate a missing compatible production capability. Unknown: real-player preference and natural physical-phone behavior for the current rotary-wheel build remain unverified.

The PR #12 fuel.mjs snapshot and current unified fuel.mjs show the V1-to-V2 difference; current loadFuel explicitly migrates old version-1 amounts.

Current templates/web-lite/h5-source-mobile-v1/racing/mobile.mjs imports RaceWheelSteering and has pointer capture fallback plus pointer cancellation/release handlers; current racing/wheel-steering.mjs calculates angular deltas.

Current templates/web-lite/h5-source-mobile-v1/racing/driver.mjs says the two-key auto-driver is deleted; PR #56 V63 notes describe the different floating-wheel semantics, while PR #57 control-lab notes mark the experiment internal-only.
findings.recommendation: No additional production capability from these branches is supported as a required omission by the Git/diff evidence. Do not merge the old two-button/practice path, the QA-only A/B harness, or the incompatible floating-joystick model into the current rotary-wheel runtime. Keep real-phone/natural-input validation as an unresolved product-evidence item, not a code cherry-pick.
